plugins.name: fluent
plugins.description: Fluent — AI Language Learning Kit. Personal AI tutor for any target language (Dutch, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, and more). Uses spaced repetition (SM-2), active recall, adaptive difficulty, and progress tracking across 6 databases. Run /fluent-setup to onboard, then /fluent-learn, /fluent-vocab, /fluent-writing, /fluent-speaking, /fluent-reading, /fluent-review daily; /fluent-listening and /fluent-pronunciation for real audio (local TTS + Whisper, no cloud).

author.name: Mohammad Kermani (upstream) · voice features by LuFennema
